decision.S_forecast_gate: Score the independent fixed five-point S task with proper probabilities and its own earlier-TRAIN prior; a better S score alone is not economic Edge.
decision.S_role: Retain causal M5/M15/H1/H4/D1 dynamic S as a separate market-state forecast and context. Do not convert future certified S side into an Entry action.
decision.comparison: Fit and any threshold only on earlier mature TRAIN. Score the fixed later 4096 development rows in time order against frozen TRAIN prior and predeclared always-LONG/always-SHORT/FLAT references on identical observable populations. Report all six horizons, selected and abstained rows, coverage, weekly uncertainty, costs and open-position limitations. No horizon or threshold selection from later scores.
decision.one_next_hypothesis: Earlier mature Fold2 causal XAU+full-GC five-TF inputs contain incremental information about both LONG and SHORT M5 cost-adjusted terminal markout and conservative pre-MFE MAE on the six fixed observation horizons, beyond an earlier-fit frozen constant prior.
decision.target_scope: Keep all physical M5 decision rows and both executable sides. Use separate terminal and complete-path observation masks and the existing causal price/cost authority; do not use future S labels or future availability as model input.

next_gate: Bind an exact single-hypothesis model and frozen earlier-TRAIN prior recipe with optimizer/resume proof and a fixed chronological scoring protocol. Seek separate exact admission before any fit. Do not launch a broad round; keep TEST, broker and trading closed.

reuse_candidate.existing_decoder: The existing entry_only_dynamic_m5_path decoder already has a shared 1..480 minute query, two-side terminal-net, MFE and conservative pre-MFE-MAE outputs. All six fixed observation points are in its query grid. Reuse is a source candidate only; the Fold2 S task and this Entry model have different target and cohort bindings.
